title: fix(ssr): rewrite computed key of destructing parameter
body: I think `AssignmentPattern` does not have to be special cased here. It is handled inside `handlePattern` now and we can rely on that instead. I think that's also better because it will handle recursive cases. fixes https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23232 close https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/23233 close https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/23304 --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬
